Northern Tanzania

Where the story begins

In the shadow of Mount Kilimanjaro lies the only place on earth where tanzanite has ever been found.

02

Kilimanjaro

Born at the foot of Kilimanjaro

Tanzanite is found in only one location on earth, a narrow strip of land near Mount Kilimanjaro in Tanzania.

03

From the earth

Rare today. Finite tomorrow

Tanzanite's rarity is not a marketing idea. It is a geological fact. With supply limited to one known source, its scarcity is both real and deeply compelling.
